data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (open Attractions & Tickets, enter city/destination, enter keyword, search, sort, open a result), but it fixes the final action to viewing the Nearby tab instead of parameterizing it (view nearby or add to favorites), and it names the opened result as a parameter instead of using the top result. Those gaps leave it slightly vague, though a browser automation could still be built from the spec.
